read.thesis: Enterprise organic bookings up 24% and Q1 book-to-bill near 150% with backlog at $10.7B; organic growth guide raised to about 7%, but price assumption rose to nearly 2 points on tariffs and inflation.

utilisation.quote: in the majority of our factories, we are only running two shifts; in fact, some are only running one shift.

capex.quote: we raised it to 2% to 3% of revenue to capture the expanded production in Florida and in Texas

triggers.label: Enterprise bookings up 24%
triggers.quote: exceptional enterprise organic bookings, up 24%, and record backlog of 10.7 billion, up over 30% versus year-end 2025

triggers.label: Organic growth guide raised to ~7%
triggers.quote: We are increasing our organic revenue growth guidance to approximately 7%, the high end of our prior range

triggers.label: CapEx raised to 2-3% of revenue
triggers.quote: we raised it to 2% to 3% of revenue to capture the expanded production in Florida and in Texas

triggers.label: Price assumption ~1.5 → ~2 points
triggers.quote: It is probably a little higher than that, closer to two points at the enterprise level now

triggers.label: Factories on one to two shifts
triggers.quote: in the majority of our factories, we are only running two shifts; in fact, some are only running one shift

guidance.quote: We are increasing our organic revenue growth guidance to approximately 7%, the high end of our prior range of approximately 6% to 7%.
Our reported revenue guidance moves to approximately 9.5% with unchanged estimates for approximately two points of M&A and 50 basis points of favorable FX.
We are also increasing our adjusted EPS guidance range to $14.75 to $14.95
For Q2 2026, expect approximately 5% organic revenue growth and adjusted EPS in the range of $4.20 to $4.25.
we raised it to 2% to 3% of revenue to capture the expanded production in Florida and in Texas

red_flags.label: EMEA/Middle East Q2 headwind ~$50M revenue, ~$0.50 EPS
red_flags.quote: We do expect continued headwinds in the second quarter, approximately 50 million in revenues representing an estimated $0.50 EPS impact in Q2.

red_flags.label: Customer lead times stretching to 12-18 months in some verticals
red_flags.quote: In some verticals, we are seeing that being extended—12 months, 18 months in some cases, for sure

evasions.topic: Price increase for 2026 and tariff dollar impact
evasions.quote: I am not going to size the dollar impact for competitive reasons.
At this point, I do not want to get ahead of our businesses on price for the year.
